newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bell Securities sees aluminium prices rising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bell Securities sees aluminium prices rising.

text.p: Aluminium prices are expected to continue rising through 1997 on strengthening demand, broker Bell Securities Ltd said on Wednesday.

Higher demand for aluminium was being reflected in rising premiums of greater than six U.S. cents a pound over the benchmark London Metal Exchange (LME) price following a lowering of inventories last year, Bell said in a report.
"Aluminium prices are likely to continue rising through 1997," the report said.
Prices were being helped also by a reduced pressure to hedge future production owing to a growing backwardation that had emerged over the last two months, Bell said.
However, a key factor this year and in 1998 would be the rate at which idle smelting capacity totalling nearly one million tonnes of aluminium was restarted, it said.

"This will determine the net supply/demand balance and could limit the price rise as new capacity under construction will be completed regardless of price and world consumption growth of three percent in each year equates to only 1.3 million tonnes," Bell said.
